queries.label: point lookup by __rowid
queries.sql: SELECT * FROM flightperf_12f3af966f3f_sales WHERE __rowid = 4242

queries.label: indexed filter + top 10
queries.sql: SELECT order_id, product, quantity FROM flightperf_12f3af966f3f_sales WHERE country = 'JPN' AND status = 'shipped' ORDER BY quantity DESC LIMIT 10

queries.label: indexed range COUNT
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM flightperf_12f3af966f3f_sales WHERE quantity BETWEEN 5 AND 10

queries.label: LIKE prefix COUNT
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM flightperf_12f3af966f3f_sales WHERE product LIKE 'gi%'

queries.label: interval range COUNT
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM flightperf_12f3af966f3f_sales WHERE ordered_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-12-31 00:00:00' - INTERVAL '30 days'

queries.label: GROUP BY, index reduce
queries.sql: SELECT country, COUNT(*), SUM(quantity) FROM flightperf_12f3af966f3f_sales GROUP BY country

queries.label: GROUP BY, driver (AVG double)
queries.sql: SELECT country, AVG(discount) FROM flightperf_12f3af966f3f_sales GROUP BY country

queries.label: GROUP BY expression, driver
queries.sql: SELECT product, SUM(quantity * unit_price) FROM flightperf_12f3af966f3f_sales GROUP BY product

queries.label: GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC, driver
queries.sql: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', ordered_at) AS m, COUNT(*) FROM flightperf_12f3af966f3f_sales GROUP BY m ORDER BY m

queries.label: non-indexed filter (scan)
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM flightperf_12f3af966f3f_sales WHERE notes LIKE '%order 1%'

queries.label: fetch 10% of rows
queries.sql: SELECT order_id, country, quantity FROM flightperf_12f3af966f3f_sales WHERE order_id <= 10000

queries.label: full scan, all columns
queries.sql: SELECT * FROM flightperf_12f3af966f3f_sales

queries.label: selective join (index lookup)
queries.sql: SELECT c.name, COUNT(*) FROM flightperf_12f3af966f3f_sales s JOIN flightperf_12f3af966f3f_customers c ON s.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE c.country = 'JPN' AND s.status = 'shipped' GROUP BY c.name

queries.label: unfiltered join (hash join)
queries.sql: SELECT c.country, COUNT(*) FROM flightperf_12f3af966f3f_sales s JOIN flightperf_12f3af966f3f_customers c ON s.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.country

queries.label: correlated subquery (50 rows)
queries.sql: SELECT c.name, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM flightperf_12f3af966f3f_sales s WHERE s.customer_id = c.customer_id) FROM flightperf_12f3af966f3f_customers c

queries.label: IN (SELECT …), half the rows
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM flightperf_12f3af966f3f_sales WHERE order_id IN (SELECT order_id FROM flightperf_12f3af966f3f_sales WHERE quantity > 10)

queries.label: correlated EXISTS (semi-join)
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM flightperf_12f3af966f3f_sales s WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM flightperf_12f3af966f3f_sales r WHERE r.order_id = s.order_id AND r.quantity > 10)

queries.label: correlated EXISTS, no inner rows
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM flightperf_12f3af966f3f_sales s WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM flightperf_12f3af966f3f_sales r WHERE r.order_id = s.order_id AND r.quantity > 20)

queries.label: UNION of two filters
queries.sql: SELECT order_id FROM flightperf_12f3af966f3f_sales WHERE country = 'JPN' AND quantity = 20 UNION SELECT order_id FROM flightperf_12f3af966f3f_sales WHERE product = 'gizmo' AND quantity = 20

queries.label: view with pushed filter
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM flightperf_12f3af966f3f_bench_shipped WHERE country = 'JPN' AND quantity >= 15
